title.narrative: Program to Strengthen Self Reliance and Resilience of Tibetan Communities in South Asia

description.narrative: (India): ..This implementing mechanism will strengthen the resilience of Tibetan communities in India and Nepal by improving livelihoods options and strengthening local institutions. .. ..Using FY 2022 funds, USAID will continue to work towards strengthening the self-reliance and resilience of the Tibetan communities in India and Nepal by improving their livelihoods and strengthening local institutions. The overall goal of the program is to strengthen the self-reliance and resilience of Tibetan communities through sustainable livelihood improvement and strengthened local institutions. Institution strengthening focuses on the Central Tibetan Administration (CTA) and CTA's partner organizations, and a small grants fund focusing on Tibetan arts, language, and culture, which contributes to cultural preservation and resilience. USAID continues to work across several sectors aimed to increase household incomes and employment, improve education quality and access to higher education, improve community health, and increase gender equity while promoting zero-tolerance towards sexual and gender-based violence thereby empowering Tibetan women. It will continue to support several key cultural institutions to strengthen their programs and financial sustainability and promote and preserve Tibetan language and arts, among other cultural heritage initiatives. USAID will utilize the FY 2022 funds to digitize rare Tibetan manuscripts and archives, contributing to the overarching objective of protecting, preserving and restoring Tibetan culture and heritage...This implementing mechanism contributes $4,000,000 in FY 2022 ESF funding to the Tibetan Communities earmark of $8 million... ..
